'''Note:''' '''Virtual Original''' era (2002&ndash;2009). This page covers the '''original numbered Virtual Sets''' released by the [[Players Committee]] from '''2002 through the September 2009 Block reorganization'''. It is '''not''' the same packaging as the later [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Block]] hubs on this wiki, and it is '''not''' the post-2014 [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Current Virtual]] pool. For a full era map see [[History of the Players Committee]], [[Formats]], and [[Rulebooks]].

The '''Virtual Sets (2002-2009)''' (also called '''pre-reorg Virtual Sets''') were printable PDF game-text slips that players sleeved over Decipher cards. Contemporary announcements described them as a pilot program to revive underused cards and strengthen storyline play. Early slips used a '''modifier / framing style that is very different''' from how the same virtual lineage was later presented after the '''2009 Block reorg''' (and different again from '''current Virtual''' slanted-ring sets after the '''2014 Reset''').

This wiki does '''not''' yet publish a card-by-card comparison of old Virtual modifiers versus Block-era or current Virtual printings. A later wiki slice is planned for that work. Until then, treat original PDFs, Block packaging, and current Virtual as '''versioned layers''' - do not collapse them into a single "Standard" view.

== How early Virtual worked (2002 framing) ==

Per Decipher / Players Committee material from early 2002:

* Virtual cards were distributed as '''PDF slips''' to print and insert in opaque sleeves with the matching Decipher card.<ref name="tfn2002">[https://theforce.net/ccg/story/Players_Committee_Announces_the_First_Virtual_Card_Set_68946.asp Player's Committee Announces the First Virtual Card Set], TheForce.Net, 12 February 2002 (citing Game Players Network)</ref><ref name="decivs1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020610072829/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee/virtualcardset1.html Virtual Card Set #1 is Away!], decipher.com (Wayback, 10 June 2002 snapshot; dated 5 March 2002)</ref>
* Virtual versions were marked with '''(V)''' in rulings, articles, and deck lists.<ref name="decivs1" />
* Players could include both the original Decipher text and the (V) version in a deck, but could not switch a card either way once a tournament began.<ref name="decivs1" />
* An early official slip PDF survives as [https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf VirtualCards1.pdf] (Wayback, 13 August 2005 snapshot of decipher.com). The CDN host for day-to-day citation is [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf] (VirtualCards1.pdf is '''403''' on that CDN). Wayback also has VirtualCards1a.pdf and the early VirtualCards1.pdf framing file.<ref name="vc1pdf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf VirtualCards1.pdf], decipher.com virtual cardlists (Wayback)</ref><ref name="vc1apdf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070117223920/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf], decipher.com (Wayback)</ref>

'''Presentation gap (honest):''' those early PDF slips show compact replacement game-text boxes for specific Premiere cards. After September 2009, the Players Committee reorganized Legacy Virtual material into '''Virtual Blocks''' (and later published [[Virtual Shields]] as its own Legacy hub on this wiki). Post-2014 '''Current Virtual''' sets again use different set icons, numbering, and legal pools. Titles, frames, legality, and which cards remain in the pool can differ across those eras - including through '''errata''' and cards being '''dropped''' from the legal pool. Documented change-by-change diffs belong in a later page; this overview only flags that the layers are not identical.

=== Errata / official-text layers (pre-Block) ===

These are '''version stamps''' on surviving PDFs -- not a claim that each date is the only reprint, and '''not''' a drop-list.

! Layer stamp !! What it marks !! Conf. !! Notes
|-
| '''4 December 2006''' "Official text as of..." || V7-V11 slip PDFs on res || '''high''' as stamp; '''low''' as first-ship || Redux-era packaging caveat -- do not treat as proven original ship dates
|-

| '''7 December 2009''' Block "Official text as of..." || VirtualBlock1-5.pdf (and peers) || '''high''' || Reorg of previous 18 sets into six thematic blocks<ref name="blockreorg" />

'''Drops:''' Virtual cards '''can be dropped''' from the legal pool (and errata'd) across eras. A sourced '''drop-list''' is '''not''' published here yet -- later wiki slice.

A later wiki page will compare old Virtual modifiers vs Block-era / current Virtual '''card-by-card'''; this page only flags that the layers diverge.

'''Still open:''' first-ship dates for V5-V6 and V7-V11; Premium Shields legal day. '''V18 / Fifth Anthology:''' no standalone VirtualCards18.pdf shipped on CDN; preview material released via Reflections IV (see row 18) &mdash; not an open &ldquo;cancelled set&rdquo; like [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|Galaxy At War]].

== After September 2009: Blocks (not a silent rename) ==

'''Fifth Anthology / Original VS18:''' Previewed '''8 June 2009''' as the 18th virtual set, but '''never''' published as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards18.pdf VirtualCards18.pdf]. Preview titles (and verified gametext for Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force and Maneuvering Flaps & Nick Of Time) appear in '''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''' ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], official text '''4 September 2009''') / [[Virtual Block 6]]. Polish inventory does '''not''' mark it ''(niewydany)'' (only [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|Galaxy At War]]). See [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]] for the naming/PDF note. Do '''not''' confuse with modern [[Virtual Set 18]] (21 April 2022). The [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] is unrelated.

PC '''Virtual Block''' PDFs (e.g. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf]) are stamped '''Official text as of 7 December 2009''' and state: "Since the reorganization of the previous 18 virtual sets, there are now six blocks structured by theme..."<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (same blurb on VirtualBlock2-5.pdf)</ref> Soft Aug/Sep 2009 announces exist in period channels; use '''7 Dec 2009''' as the firm PDF stamp.

This wiki hubs [[Virtual Block 1]] ... [[Virtual Block 9]] plus [[Virtual Shields]]. The PC slips library separates '''Legacy Virtual Sets (2002-2009)''' from '''Legacy Virtual Blocks (2009-2014)'''.<ref name="slips" />

That means:

* '''Old Virtual Set PDFs / modifier slips''' remain historical printings.
* '''Block packaging''' is a later organizational and presentational layer for the pre-Reset pool.
* '''Current Virtual''' (from [[Virtual Set 0]] / the '''24 September 2014''' Reset onward on this wiki's Main Page) is a third era for tournament Standard play.

Cards could be '''errata'd''' or '''dropped''' from the legal pool between eras. [[Formats]] distinguishes '''Legacy''' (pre-Reset virtual pool) from '''Standard''' (post-Reset). Rules documents likewise version by era: Decipher core books, [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0|Advanced Rulebook 2.0]] (Legacy Virtual-era), and the current [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023).
